title: D CORE SC-LC 5M Single-Mode Fiber Patch Cable

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE LC-LC 5M Single-Mode Duplex Fiber Patch Cable is a premium-quality OS2 9/125µm SMF fiber jumper designed to deliver stable, long-range, and low-attenuation performance for professional networking environments. With LC to LC connectors, this 5-meter OS2 single-mode patch cord ensures excellent signal clarity, making it perfect for connecting switches, routers, servers, media converters, OLT/ONT devices, and optical transceivers.


Engineered with precision-polished connectors and high-grade single-mode fiber, it supports high-speed applications including 1G, 10G, 25G, 40G, and 100G SM optical modules. The durable duplex design ensures reliable performance in data centers, enterprise networks, ISP backbones, and telecom installations.


Key Features

  • Connector Type: LC to LC, duplex
  • Fiber Type: OS2 Single-Mode (9/125µm)
  • Length: 5 meters
  • Supports long-distance optical transmission
  • Ultra-low insertion loss and high return loss
  • Compatible with SFP/SFP+/SFP28/10G/25G/100G SM optics
  • Durable jacket suitable for rack and patch panel installations
  • Ideal for data centers, telecom, FTTH, and enterprise networks


If you're looking for a dependable single-mode LC-LC patch cable in Bangladesh, D CORE offers guaranteed quality, reliable performance, and competitive pricing.
